title: Joining the Magnolia Band: leaders and members
summary: He joined the Magnolia Band about 1907-08. Louis Keppard managed it, his brother Willie Foster led it, and members included Eddie Atkins, Dutrey, King Oliver and Picou.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So when did you start to play regularly in New Orleans? About 1907 or eight around there? When you were 15 or 16, huh?
Well, I went to McNoly Band.

The Magnolia Band. The Magnolia Band. Yeah. See how you are. Then I started playing the Magnolia Band because we had a... We had such a terrific band. We take all the way from the Emperor Band, Spirit Band. It was a good band. But we take all the way because we had a better band than them.
Who was the leader of the Magnolia Band? And who was the leader of the Magnolia Band?
Louis Kepp. Louis Kepp. See, he had manager and leader.
Louis Kepp. And the leader? My brother.
Why did your brother play? Violin. What's his first name? Willie. Willie. Willie Foster. Yeah. I had Eddie Atkins. First we had Eddie Atkins.

We had Duterte for a while. We had Eddie Atkins and Duterte. King Oliver. Uh-huh. King Oliver. Uh-huh. Piku. Uh-huh. Had a guy called Chris. I never know what Chris's last name. Blaine Drum. Myself. Louis Kepp played guitar. We had a good band. Did you have some kind of a uniform? Yeah.
